compute_moving_average: compute a moving average of a numpy array with a configurable window size
calculate_total_energy_drift: calculate the total energy drift from an NVE MD trajectory file after removing equilibration steps
join_nve_md_results: join NVE MD drift results from multiple trajectory files in a directory using a glob pattern
compute_nve_md_metrics: compute the mean drift in meV per atom per second from a list of NVE MD results
save_nve_md_metrics: save NVE MD benchmark metrics to a JSON file in the specified results directory
